evals.prompt: Use the intake-triage skill. Triage the intake queue for TaskFlow. I want to see what's waiting. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: Lists intake items sorted by age, proposes a decision (accept/defer/reject) for each using the routing rules.
expectations: The answer says to consult connector-bootstrap
The answer says to call intake(action=list, project_id) (following next_cursor) and sorts by age
The answer classifies each item per the routing rules
The answer produces a triage session summary table
